scenarios.title: Clare County transportation resilience
scenarios.expected_story: Shows a rural transportation project moving from project need to ranked grants and readiness memo.
scenarios.project_description: Clare County needs funding to improve a flood-prone rural road corridor with bridge and culvert upgrades, drainage improvements, ditch grading, and safer access for residents and emergency vehicles.

scenarios.title: Stormwater resilience
scenarios.expected_story: Shows drainage, culvert, and resilience needs.
scenarios.project_description: A Michigan township needs funding to reduce flooding along a residential road corridor with drainage improvements, culvert replacement, ditch grading, and green infrastructure where feasible.
